A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CSC induces CYP1A1 and CYP1B in oral cancer cells, which may play a role in the activation of tobacco carcinogens and in the development of OSCC.
CSC induces a set of detoxifying and antioxidant genes in normal and malignant cells, and that this response may be a key element in the prevention and/or repair of tobacco-related oral carcinogens.
CSC induces the expression of genes involved in the metabolism and detoxification of tobacco-derived carcinogens, which may be a mechanism of protection against tobacco-related oral cancer.

cigarette smoke condensates can induce a number of genes that may play a role in the development of oral cancers in smokers.
